coverage: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30) · Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30) · Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)

sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x bodyvests, 2x radios, 1x Ops phone, 2x cameras, 2x camera chargers. All photos/video involving incidents attached following end of shift.
Morning shift deployed. Patrol commenced towards Aotea Square, with welfare checks to be completed along the way.
Welfare checks at Queen Street Starbucks, Localito, McDonald's Queen Street, and 77 Convenience Store. All clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Sweep commenced.

Aotea Square all clear. Presence maintained. Call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding a vagrant sleeping outside. After confirming the individual was on a public bench, staff were advised no action could be taken as the person was on public property.
Heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Sky Tower area, 77 Convenience Store, and cafe checked. All clear. Presence maintained due to a few vagrants around the corner of the print shop and near the cafe.
St Patrick's Cathedral Church checked. All clear, no issues to report.

A group of four vagrants at the corner of Hobson Street and Wyndham Street began arguing and yelling at each other; the situation appeared to become physical. Guards intervened and de-escalated. The group moved towards Ace Karaoke Bar, so guards walked with them to ensure they did not remain near the church or cause further escalation, continuing to speak with them until they separated. During this incident a call was received from a cafe at the corner of Victoria Street, but guards were unable to respond as they were already managing the active situation.
Albert Mart Convenience Store checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Lower Albert Street bus interchange checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed around Reign & Pour and surrounding areas. TK Square all clear. Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear. Presence maintained at TK Square.
Full Queen Street sweep commenced towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Auckland Library sweep completed. All clear, no issues to report.
Lorne Street checked. All clear, no issues to report.
High Street checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Vagrants observed drinking at Vulcan Lane. Guards stopped them and asked them to close the lids; they complied. Vulcan Lane all clear. Guards headed towards Britomart via Queen Street.
Customs Street checked. All clear. Heading to Fort Lane.
Fort Lane, Gore Street, Wilson Carpark, and surrounding areas checked. All clear, no issues to report.
High Street checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Chancery Square full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
220 Queen Street and surrounding area checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Heading to Aotea Square via Queen Street sweep.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street. All clear, no issues to report.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding a vagrant sleeping inside the restaurant. Guards proceeded via Queen Street, completing a sweep towards Britomart.
Welfare checks at OPSM, Kathmandu, Macpac, and Chemist Warehouse. All clear. Presence maintained at McDonald's Queen Street / TK Square.
Heading to headquarters for lunch break while sweeping Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear. Guards remained by Starbucks while arranging access to the office.
Arrived at headquarters for lunch break and remained available for calls.
Standing by at headquarters for shift handover and calls.
Morning shift completed. All clear, no issues to report.
Continued support required as afternoon guard had left gear upstairs. Guards waited for cleaner to assist with building access.
Office accessed. Continued support provided until afternoon guard was prepared for deployment.
Handover completed. Afternoon guard prepared for deployment and debrief completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Afternoon shift team on site, but one guard had gear upstairs. Morning guard remained on overtime until access could be gained upstairs.
Cleaner en route to provide access into the building.
Team prepared and ready for deployment. Ops phone charging, battery at 7%. Presence maintained at headquarters.

Call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding teenagers on bikes standing outside the restaurant. Staff advised they were not blocking the entrance or creating issues. Advised guards could not stop them standing outside but would head towards the area to monitor.
Patrol commenced on Queen Street towards Britomart. Ops phone charged to 22%.
Full Queen Street sweep completed. No issues. Teenagers reported earlier had scattered. TK Square all clear.
Commercial Bay and surrounding areas checked, including the bus interchange. All clear. Presence maintained at TK Square.
Customs Street sweep completed. All clear, no issues to report.
Wilson Carpark, Gore Street, and Fort Lane checked. All clear, no issues to report.
High Street checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall checked. All clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Chancery Square completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Heading along Queen Street via Vulcan Lane.
Vulcan Lane checked. All clear. Restaurant businesses checked with no issues. Queen Street sweep commenced towards Aotea Square.
Welfare checks at McDonald's Queen Street, Localito, and 77 Convenience Store. All clear, no issues to report.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear. Light tunnel was up, with no issues around it. Presence maintained.
Heading to headquarters as one guard signed off at 19:30.
Guard arrived on site. Ops phone placed on charge, battery at 7%.
Patrol recommenced with Ops phone at 33%.
McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store, Localito, Timezone, and MidCity checked. All clear. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square checked. All clear. Heading towards Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Elliott Stables, Elliott Street, and Darby Street checked. All clear. Heading to office to support Rapid Response team access.
Standing by at the office to let guards upstairs.
Received one guard and awaited second guard.
Patrol recommenced, heading up Victoria Street.
Hell Pizza, The Fiddler, 77 Convenience Store, Kebab Time, and the news agency store checked. All clear. Presence maintained.
Heading through Federal Street towards Wyndham Street.
Federal Street checked. All clear, no issues.
Wyndham Street towards Queen Street checked. QF Tavern and Ding Dong Lounge checked. All clear. Heading towards office to wait for night shift team.
Arrived at office and maintained presence.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Night shift deployed. Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x vests, and 1x Ops phone.
Patrol commenced. Heading to High Street for response calls.

Arrived at first response call involving a vagrant being loud and throwing items. Guards located the individual and reached an agreement with him (video on file). Guards also notified a group of four about the liquor ban area and asked them to move to a private area or their vehicles. Presence maintained.
Heading to Snickel Lane for response call.
Undercover Police officer in plain clothes observed parked on High Street.
Hasi sent photo of a POI tagging a building near Metropolis. Guards kept watch for the POI. (photos/video on file)
Arrived at Snickel Lane response call. Staff advised a male wearing a white hat had asked uncomfortable questions to a female worker. (photo on file)
Large Police presence observed at Britomart. (video on file)
Britomart and Commercial Bay checked. All clear. Presence maintained.
Guards were approached by a female who stated she had been robbed by a large group of males riding bikes. She later advised it was okay and that she would follow up herself.
Sapphire had a Latino event on. Area all clear. Heading towards Queen Street.
Received a response call from Kemuri regarding a group of adults harassing a security guard.
Arrived at Kemuri. Staff advised the group of adults had already left. Presence maintained. Large number of Police observed in vehicles and on foot.
Kemuri all clear, no further issues. Patrol continued.
Welfare checks at Sapphire and Britomart. All clear. Heading back to headquarters to charge Ops phone, battery at 4%.
Arrived at headquarters. Ops phone placed on charge, battery at 2%. Remained available for response calls.
Responding to a call from Q Convenience Store.

Arrived at Q Convenience Store. Staff advised a male wanted an item they did not have and became difficult; he was asked to leave but refused. When guards arrived, the male left towards McDonald's Britomart.
Urgent call received from Niks requesting guards attend the old Smith & Caughey's area for a potential brawl. Guards proceeded to location at pace.
Arrived in front of Father Ted's. Altercation had been resolved.
Guards followed and monitored the victim group of four, who were heading up Wellesley Street towards Kitchener Street.

Instigating group was sent away from the victim group. Guards remained with a male who was upset and angry about the way the other group had behaved. Guards kept the group safe and ensured they entered their transport safely (video on file). Heading towards Bar101.
Groups of juveniles observed drinking in public. Guards confiscated alcohol from them without issue. McDonald's Queen Street checked and all clear. Continuing patrol.
Welfare check at Bar101. Presence maintained. All clear, no further issues.
Welfare check at Britomart. Presence maintained.
Arrived at headquarters. Ops phone placed on charge due to low battery.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street. All clear, no further issues.
Alcohol removed from a group of minors.
Welfare check at Bar101. All clear.
Heading back to headquarters. Floor checks commencing.
